title: Adding Custom Content to the Homepage Hero Section
text:
## Adding Custom Content to the Homepage Hero Section
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000055030
To learn how to call a custom search module widget on a homepage as Custom Homepage Content, follow these steps:

## 1. Remove the search module or select the option to add a Hero Message with button Links:
- To remove the search module navigate to the Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage Tab >> Search Box / Call to Action :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124819877/original/1-2jES9_HHjnga6DPtNHtQsFG6RmDKuMug.jpeg?1682975758 | alt: ]
On Homepage Search Box Call to Action, select the Call to Action as " Hide Search Module / Call to Action ":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124819884/original/O65LgfK4kg49wPS2ieJ_BeKCPjUYEfciew.jpeg?1682975768 | alt: ]
- To learn how to add the Hero Message with links, refer to this article Hero Message with Links - Up to Three Buttons on Homepage
This example shows what a homepage looks like when using the Display Buttons Links option:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12125211199/original/N-7Cmf5IjQgA_JKvC9MsmpmxtteSm72YIw.png?1683658185 | alt: ]

## 2. Call the preferred search filter widget on the homepage.
- Search the preferred widget by navigating to Toolbox - Widget Manager and copy its short code for future usage:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124819917/original/omijT2vaGUjYYd4jFtsI2xX-f6MU-hUnvQ.jpeg?1682975794 | alt: ]
- Navigate to My Content >> Web Page Builder >> Click "Edit" on Homepage :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124819938/original/xdwVOUDRIg9MByzAKHtUS_8qkSuQBrZFqA.png?1682975811 | alt: ]
- Paste the shortcode copied earlier to the Page Content and Save:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124819941/original/GrWET7iR8lI4RPwUHK0P4eXsX6nMO2pIDA.jpeg?1682975824 | alt: ]

## 3. Add the custom search module to the Homepage:
-Navigate to Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage Tab >> Enable Additional Sections >> Select Content to Display
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12125211320/original/1yrvToSUeWHOUZbEEdzrwMJm68rdeifu9A.png?1683658254 | alt: ]
- In Select Content to Display, select Custom Homepage Content on a preferred Section:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12125211439/original/FNaTyNcxFI2cYSXsp8q40JABSye5uXBW6A.png?1683658317 | alt: ]
This is an example of what the homepage looks like with the custom search widget and the links:

## How to Add Custom Content Above or Below the Hero Section:
We created these two empty widgets into the homepage hero code:
Bootstrap Theme - Homepage Search - Extra Content Above
Bootstrap Theme - Homepage Search - Extra Content Below
These widgets allow users to easily add content directly above and below homepage search modules without customizing other important widgets:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12125990105/original/ruOceqRgxZVUZ3-HqocH7sgw5TMDUszngQ.png?1685033806 | alt: ]
Once the custom content is saved into the widget:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12125990312/original/IqDenuwuMZUa_X73SHQBP_yi1BcPfcJyoQ.png?1685033982 | alt: ]
The content will display in the corresponding placements in the hero section:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12125990467/original/UzfMFIgLkWnBmAF-Q1tXV9YTNi5RHFXkwg.png?1685034154 | alt: ]
